This post is a [Pluto.jl](https://plutojl.org/) notebook exploring cocktail shaking with [ModelingToolkit.jl](https://github.com/SciML/ModelingToolkit.jl). It models the thermodynamics of shaking — how ice melts, dilutes, and cools a cocktail, and how that affects perceived sweetness.

[View the interactive notebook](notebook.html){.btn .btn-primary}
